# API reference

Generated from the source of `github.com/otfabric/go-openadr` with `docsync api`; the doc comments are the documentation. The guides around it explain how the pieces fit.

| Package | Synopsis |
|---|---|
| [github.com/otfabric/go-openadr](go-openadr.md) | Package openadr defines the domain model of OpenADR 3: programs, events, reports, VENs, resources and the value types they are built from. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-openadr/auth](auth.md) | Package auth holds what the VTN needs to authenticate and authorize a request: the identity behind a bearer token and the OAuth2 scopes of OpenADR 3. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-openadr/client](client.md) | Package client holds the two clients of a VTN: VEN, for a virtual end node, and BL, for the Business Logic of a utility or aggregator. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-openadr/discovery](discovery.md) | Package discovery finds VTNs on the local network, and lets a VTN be found, with DNS-SD over Multicast DNS as OpenADR 3.1.0 describes it ("Discovery and Configuration of Local VTNs"): the service type is _openadr3._tcp, and a TXT record carries the version, the base path and URL of the API, the program names and whether the VTN authenticates. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-openadr/notification/mqtt](notification-mqtt.md) | Package mqtt is the MQTT binding of OpenADR 3 notifications, for both sides: Publisher sends a VTN's notifications to a broker, and Subscriber receives them in a client. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-openadr/notification/webhook](notification-webhook.md) | Package webhook is the webhook binding of OpenADR 3 notifications, for both sides: Sender delivers a VTN's notifications to the callback URLs of its subscriptions, and Handler receives them in a client. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-openadr/notification/websocket](notification-websocket.md) | Package websocket receives the notifications of a VTN over a WebSocket. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-openadr/objectjson](objectjson.md) | Package objectjson gives the objects of package openadr the JSON of a revision of OpenADR: the representation a VTN of that revision answers with. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-openadr/server](server.md) | Package server is an OpenADR 3.1.0 VTN as an http.Handler. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-openadr/server/storage](server-storage.md) | Package storage is the persistence boundary of the VTN. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-openadr/server/storage/storagetest](server-storage-storagetest.md) | Package storagetest is a test suite for implementations of storage.Store. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-openadr/timeline](timeline.md) | Package timeline turns the intervals of an event or a report into a table: one row per period of time and payload, with the start and end worked out. |
